title: MT61322: Electronics In Industry
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to Industrial Electronics; Fundamentals of Analog Signal
conditioning; Operational Amplifiers; Voltage-to-Current and Current-to-Voltage
Converters, A/D and D/A Converters; Fundamentals of Power conditioning; SCRs,
Triacs, IGBT and other Thyristerised devices and their Industrial Applications;
Introduction to Digital Electronics, Fundamentals of Microprocessors and
Interfacing, Data Acquisition Systems; Introduction to Lasers, Optical Fibres
and other Optoelectronic Devices; Introduction to Industrial Communication;
Serial and Parallel Communication Principles LAN/WAN standards, Optical and
Wireless Networking.
